/*
 * Generated by SEMAPRAX Public Generic Consumer v1
 * (semaprax.public-generic-consumer-metadata.v1).
 * Compiler-generated deterministic output; do not edit.
 *
 * This reads public generic *metadata*. It is not a calling convention: it
 * receives no SEMAPRAX value, allocates none, frees none, and links against
 * nothing. The declarations below show the substituted field tree in C; they
 * define no layout, no ownership transfer, and no ABI.
 */
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#define SPX_PG_MAX_DEPTH 64
#define SPX_PG_MAX_NODES 4096
#define SPX_PG_MAX_FIELDS 8
#define SPX_PG_MAX_RECORDS 8192
#define SPX_PG_MAX_BYTES 1048576

/* A borrowed view of owned bytes, for declarations only. */
struct spx_pg_bytes {
    const uint8_t *data;
    uint64_t len;
};

__DECLARATIONS__
static const uint8_t spx_pg_expected[] = {
__EXPECTED__
};

static const char *const spx_pg_scalars[] = {"bytes", "usize", "bool", "char",
                                             "i64",   "i32",   "f32",  "f64",
                                             "u8"};

/* A decimal count, without a leading zero, terminated by `stop`. */
static size_t spx_pg_decimal(const uint8_t *bytes, size_t len, size_t at,
                             uint8_t stop, size_t *out) {
    size_t start = at;
    size_t value = 0;
    while (at < len && bytes[at] >= '0' && bytes[at] <= '9') {
        size_t digit = (size_t)(bytes[at] - '0');
        if (value > (SIZE_MAX - digit) / 10u) {
            return SIZE_MAX;
        }
        value = value * 10u + digit;
        at++;
    }
    if (at == start || (at - start > 1 && bytes[start] == '0')) {
        return SIZE_MAX;
    }
    if (at >= len || bytes[at] != stop) {
        return SIZE_MAX;
    }
    *out = value;
    return at + 1;
}

/* One canonical grammar term. Returns the offset after it, or SIZE_MAX. */
static size_t spx_pg_term(const uint8_t *bytes, size_t len, size_t at,
                          size_t depth, size_t *nodes) {
    if (depth > SPX_PG_MAX_DEPTH || at >= len) {
        return SIZE_MAX;
    }
    *nodes += 1;
    if (*nodes > SPX_PG_MAX_NODES) {
        return SIZE_MAX;
    }
    if (bytes[at] == '@') {
        size_t identity = 0;
        at = spx_pg_decimal(bytes, len, at + 1, ':', &identity);
        if (at == SIZE_MAX || identity > len - at) {
            return SIZE_MAX;
        }
        for (size_t index = 0; index < identity; index++) {
            if (bytes[at + index] == 0) {
                return SIZE_MAX;
            }
        }
        at += identity;
        if (at >= len || bytes[at] != '<') {
            return SIZE_MAX;
        }
        at++;
        if (at < len && bytes[at] == '>') {
            return at + 1;
        }
        for (;;) {
            at = spx_pg_term(bytes, len, at, depth + 1, nodes);
            if (at == SIZE_MAX || at >= len) {
                return SIZE_MAX;
            }
            if (bytes[at] == ',') {
                at++;
                continue;
            }
            if (bytes[at] == '>') {
                return at + 1;
            }
            return SIZE_MAX;
        }
    }
    for (size_t index = 0; index < sizeof spx_pg_scalars / sizeof *spx_pg_scalars;
         index++) {
        size_t width = strlen(spx_pg_scalars[index]);
        if (len - at >= width &&
            memcmp(bytes + at, spx_pg_scalars[index], width) == 0) {
            return at + width;
        }
    }
    return SIZE_MAX;
}

/* NULL when the document is the expected one; otherwise a closed reason. */
static const char *spx_pg_verify(const uint8_t *bytes, size_t len) {
    static const char magic[] = "spxpgcm1;";
    const size_t magic_len = sizeof magic - 1;
    if (len > SPX_PG_MAX_BYTES || len < magic_len ||
        memcmp(bytes, magic, magic_len) != 0) {
        return "malformed";
    }
    size_t at = magic_len;
    size_t records = 0;
    while (at < len) {
        if (bytes[at] != '|') {
            return "malformed";
        }
        size_t count = 0;
        at = spx_pg_decimal(bytes, len, at + 1, ';', &count);
        if (at == SIZE_MAX || count == 0 || count > SPX_PG_MAX_FIELDS) {
            return "malformed";
        }
        size_t starts[SPX_PG_MAX_FIELDS];
        size_t widths[SPX_PG_MAX_FIELDS];
        for (size_t index = 0; index < count; index++) {
            size_t width = 0;
            at = spx_pg_decimal(bytes, len, at, ':', &width);
            if (at == SIZE_MAX || width > len - at) {
                return "malformed";
            }
            for (size_t byte = 0; byte < width; byte++) {
                if (bytes[at + byte] == 0) {
                    return "malformed";
                }
            }
            starts[index] = at;
            widths[index] = width;
            at += width;
            if (at >= len || bytes[at] != ';') {
                return "malformed";
            }
            at++;
        }
        size_t term = SPX_PG_MAX_FIELDS;
        if (widths[0] == 1) {
            uint8_t kind = bytes[starts[0]];
            bool data3 = count == 6 && widths[3] == 4 &&
                         memcmp(bytes + starts[3], "data", 4) == 0;
            bool data2 = count == 4 && widths[2] == 4 &&
                         memcmp(bytes + starts[2], "data", 4) == 0;
            if (kind == 'P' && data3) {
                term = 5;
            } else if (kind == 'R' && data2) {
                term = 3;
            } else if (kind == 'I' && count == 4) {
                term = 1;
            } else if (kind == 'A' && count == 4) {
                term = 3;
            } else if (kind == 'F' && count == 5) {
                term = 4;
            }
        }
        if (term != SPX_PG_MAX_FIELDS) {
            size_t nodes = 0;
            size_t end = starts[term] + widths[term];
            if (spx_pg_term(bytes, end, starts[term], 0, &nodes) != end) {
                return "term";
            }
        }
        records++;
        if (records > SPX_PG_MAX_RECORDS) {
            return "malformed";
        }
    }
    if (records == 0) {
        return "malformed";
    }
    if (len != sizeof spx_pg_expected ||
        memcmp(bytes, spx_pg_expected, len) != 0) {
        return "mismatch";
    }
    return NULL;
}

static int spx_pg_report(const char *refusal) {
    if (refusal != NULL) {
        printf("refused:%s\n", refusal);
        return 3;
    }
    printf("ok\n");
    return 0;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    if (argc > 2) {
        fprintf(stderr, "usage: consumer [metadata-file]\n");
        return 2;
    }
    if (argc == 1) {
        return spx_pg_report(spx_pg_verify(spx_pg_expected, sizeof spx_pg_expected));
    }
    FILE *handle = fopen(argv[1], "rb");
    if (handle == NULL) {
        fprintf(stderr, "cannot open %s\n", argv[1]);
        return 2;
    }
    static uint8_t buffer[SPX_PG_MAX_BYTES + 1];
    size_t len = fread(buffer, 1, sizeof buffer, handle);
    int failed = ferror(handle);
    (void)fclose(handle);
    if (failed != 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "cannot read %s\n", argv[1]);
        return 2;
    }
    return spx_pg_report(spx_pg_verify(buffer, len));
}
